description: METIS models European electricity, gas and heat systems through interconnected modules. The European Commission documents its use in infrastructure and market-policy studies, with technical notes, study reports and selected scripts and data. The provider is European Commission DG Energy and JRC; contracted development consortia. Coverage: The documented short-term model covers EU and neighbouring countries with hourly simulation for up to one year. Later programme phases add capabilities; dates and granularity differ by study. Access: The official page provides documentation and release-specific scripts and data links. Access to the complete executable and its licence was not established. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: METIS 4 runs through 2027 and planned extensions must not be described as already delivered. The energy model is distinct from METIS graph-partitioning software. For simulation it supports flexibility, sector-coupling and energy-infrastructure analysis. Related resources: Catalogue mentions in Grazer and Code_Saturne concern other uses of METIS, not the Commission’s energy model.
